_about: Battle tuning for BattleSim.gd. Started from prototype/battle_core.js; HP x1.6 for longer battles with 2-4 specials each, slime atk raised (6.5) so line/charge mirror matches are ~50/50 with both sides on BattleAI. Tune with tools/run_sims.gd. Times are seconds, distances are field pixels (480x240).
_field_note: background = painted 480x270 image behind the battle (horizon at y 104, ground y 104-240, darker HUD strip below); duel_background = painted 480x270 image for the generals' duel (spotlight centred on y 214, where the generals stand, top corners kept dark for the HP bars). Leave either out to get the drawn placeholder.

combat._special_take_note: true = specials are reduced by the target's order/formation damage-taken multipliers (hold, square), like normal hits.

_lanes_note: The field height (y_min..y_max) splits into this many equal lanes, top to bottom. Lane specials hit one lane; the target side dodges by opening it (split).
_commands_note: switch_delay = s the troops stand frozen after an order change (the price of reacting).
_split_note: Open a lane: troops in it step out to the neighbouring lane at speed_mult x their speed, nobody enters it for duration s, everyone hits crowd_atk x while it is open. margin = px around the lane that also counts as inside.
_duel_rules_note: When both armies are gone and both generals stand, the battle cuts to a duel (BattleSim duel section). offer_time = s each side has to choose duel or retreat (undecided = duel; retreat = lose the battle, general survives). Then turns alternate, the faster general first: start_gap s before the first blow, hit_gap s between blows in a turn, turn_gap s between turns. The player only watches.
_general_charge_note: General fights at the front: +mp_on_hit MP per hit it lands, specials launch from where it stands; takes front_take x damage out there, and channel_take x on top while channelling a special; walks back at return_spd_mult x speed when recalled (front_take still applies until it is home). A general never runs from a fight: at its post it never moves (crowding can't shove it), enemy troops spread out around it (front, back, above, below) and it cuts them down one at a time; it ignores the retreat order, and a recall while an enemy is within its reach; with no troops left it walks to the nearest enemy soldier.

general_charge.label: แม่ทัพลงสนาม

units._generals_note: Generals start at general_spot behind their army and stay there (hitting only enemies that reach them) until sent in with general_charge; sized so a general-vs-general duel (when all troops are gone) is about even: slime 310 hp / 17 atk vs knight 320 / 18. Each general has a style: front_take = its own damage-taken x when sent in (else general_charge.front_take), ai_charge = how the AI uses it: front (fights at the front from the start), mopup (goes in to finish a beaten army), never. The slime general is a brawler (strong at the front, so it pays more there); the knight general is a commander who should stay back. duel = style in the one-on-one duel (see duel_rules): hits blows per turn of power each (+- jitter share), each landing with chance accuracy. Slime general: two quick, steady blows; knight general: one heavy, swingy blow (same expected damage per turn, roughly)

_orders_note: advance = AI default from the prototype: walks in, no bonuses.
_formations_note: Spots are for an army facing right (left side of the field); a side facing left mirrors x as width - x. flank = extra atk when flank_min or more allies hit the same target. Roles toward generals: general_pull (<1 = enemy general counts as closer when picking targets, applied to squared distance), envelop (px troops swing above/below the enemy general), leash (px troops stay within of their own general).

_specials_note: Casting pays MP, then telegraph s of warning (target lane shown, general stands still), then the special launches launch_offset px in front of the general (start_x without a general) and sweeps toward the enemy at speed, a band width px deep, hitting each enemy once. lanes 0 = full field height; 1 = one lane aimed by the caster (AI, or best lane for the player). range = px travelled before it fades; damage drops to min_damage_pct % at the end (no range = full damage to end_x). knockback = px survivors are pushed back. type/color are for BattleView.

_ai_note: BattleAI, see scripts/battle/BattleAI.gd (same brain for either side). Casting: every think_interval s, hit value per enemy = share of max HP taken + kill_bonus if it dies, general x general_weight; cast when the best lane holds min_share of the value of hitting every enemy; full MP lowers it to full_mp_min_share; own general below danger_hp with enemies within danger_range: any hit, those enemies x danger_weight. Dodging: reaction_time s after an enemy cast, chance dodge_skill: open the lane if it holds dodge_min_units (general = general_weight); full-field special -> full_response order until it passes. General charge (mop-up): after charge_after s, go in at HP >= charge_hp with troop HP >= charge_adv x enemy's and at most charge_max_enemy_troops enemy troops left; come back when troop HP < return_adv x (never for low HP: a general stands and takes the hits, and a recalled one only walks back once nobody is fighting it). Duel offer: retreat if our general needs more than duel_retreat_ratio x the turns theirs needs to win.
_sprites_note: Sprite size standard (pixels at the 480x270 game resolution, shown x3 at 1440x810, x4 at 1080p): troops 32x32 frames, small slime 16x16, generals 48x48. Generals in the duel close-up are drawn at x2 (96 px tall). Strips: <dir>/<anim>.png, frames left to right, facing RIGHT. foot = frame pixel that stands on the ground; height = px above the feet for HP bars. Units without sprites use the placeholder shapes. The PNGs in assets/units are placeholders from tools/make_placeholder_sprites.py: replace them with real art of the same frame size.
_fx_sprites_note: Effect strips for specials (BattleView). file = one strip, frames left to right, moving RIGHT (flipped for the side facing left). foot = frame pixel put on the effect's point: wave = crest front on the wave front, base on each lane's bottom edge; hit = centre of the struck unit; launch = the launch point in front of the general. A special lists its effects in "fx": wave / hit / launch for a wave, rider / trail / hit for a charge (rider foot = lance tip on the ground line); anything missing is drawn with the placeholder shapes.
_sides_note: Side order matters: units spawn interleaved in this order, and if both armies die on the same step the first side wins (prototype behaviour).
